14:15.race_name: Weatherbys General Stud Book Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Chase form has gone to pot; latest hurdle run (four starts back) gives her a place chance
runners.name: Another Day Out
runners.spotlight: Three front-running chase wins in 2024, including over about 3m here; second of five at Ludlow in October but her chase form has gone to pot; latest hurdle performance (four starts back) gives her a place chance.

runners.comment: Blinkers replace cheekpieces of last four starts, in which he ran well; thorough stayer
runners.name: Castanea Breeze
runners.spotlight: Upped to an extended 2m7f for his successful handicap debut at Market Rasen (good to soft) in December; good second since at Wetherby (3m1f, soft), Fakenham (3m, soft) and Huntingdon (3m2f, good to soft); looks a thorough stayer and he'd have much more to prove on good ground; blinkers replace the cheekpieces worn on those last four starts but he has to be shortlisted.

runners.comment: Yet to show much over hurdles, on handicap debut latest; up in trip with first cheekpieces
runners.name: Jaja Jimmy
runners.spotlight: Best effort when placed in a soft-ground bumper; yet to show much over hurdles, given wind surgery before penultimate start and making his handicap debut when remote on latest (both at about 2m5f); upped in trip again, with first-time cheekpieces.

runners.comment: In-form candidate; tongue-tie is removed this time and he's not proven on good ground
runners.name: Glengolly
runners.spotlight: The tongue-tie went on for last four starts, breaking his duck in good style at Hereford (3m2f, soft) on first occasion and creditable runner-up in two of his three starts since; the exception can be forgiven on heavy ground at Ffos Las; the tongue-tie is removed this time and he's not proven on good, but otherwise he has solid each-way claims.

runners.comment: Won at Southwell and Fakenham in two of her five handicaps, all about 3m; considered
runners.name: Apieceovfortune
runners.spotlight: Won at Southwell and Fakenham in two of her five handicaps, all about 3m; not disgraced when third at Fakenham on latest outing; considered.

runners.comment: Won at Wincanton (3m, good to soft); way below form at Fontwell (3m2f, soft) next time
runners.name: Happy Returns
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the 13th attempt with an easy win at Wincanton (3m, good to soft) in December; way below form at Fontwell (3m2f, soft) next time and needs to resume her improvement.

runners.comment: Upped to 3m at Uttoxeter (good to soft) 11 weeks ago when a remote 4th on handicap debut
runners.name: Donttellyamumjack
runners.spotlight: Some bumper promise; well beaten in his four hurdle races, upped to 3m at Uttoxeter (good to soft; 9-1) 11 weeks ago when a remote fourth on handicap debut last time; needed plenty of riding that day; early days but he needs to raise his game, markedly.

runners.comment: Last two starts when 3rd at Hereford (3m2f, soft) and 2nd at Doncaster (3m, good to soft)
runners.name: Call Your Bluff
runners.spotlight: 0-8 but he's dropped 11lb since tackling handicaps and took steps forward on last two starts when third of 11 at Hereford (3m2f, soft) and second of nine at Doncaster (extended 3m, good to soft); ridden all season by Cameron Johnstone-Baker; again in serious each-way contention.

runners.comment: 0-19 under rules but solid season over about 2m4f; also has form over this sort of trip
runners.name: Time Was
runners.spotlight: 9yo who is 0-19 under rules but having a solid season over about 2m4f; also has form over this sort of trip, including at this track, and further minor honours may be possible.

runners.comment: 11-race maiden; upped to 3m1f at Plumpton latest when 19l behind runner-up Glengolly
runners.name: The Last Drop
runners.spotlight: 11-race maiden; easily best effort this season was over 2m in October, four starts back; upped to 3m1f at Plumpton latest but finished 19l behind runner-up Glengolly; 2lb out of the handicap; major work to do.

runners.comment: Seven-race maiden; trailed two of these at Plumpton (3m1f) latest; 7lb out of the handicap
runners.name: Court One
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden hurdler who was runner-up twice in Lingfield handicaps over their extended 2m3f but underperformed there next time and trailed Glengolly and The Last Drop at Plumpton (upped to 3m1f) on latest start; 7lb out of the handicap.

14:45.race_name: Weatherbys nhstallions.co.uk Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Placed on two of last three outings; blinkers replace cheekpieces; very different ground
runners.name: Dangerous Touch
runners.spotlight: 2m4f handicap hurdle winner; chasing on last four outings, falling at the first on penultimate occasion but placed in the mud at Ayr and Huntingdon (second of five over C&D) on starts either side; wore cheekpieces on last two outings, now has blinkers and very different ground.

runners.comment: In form of his life this autumn; off 4 months but the ground has come right for him again
runners.name: Ballynaheer
runners.spotlight: In the form of his life this autumn, including with wins over 3m1f/3m2f on good ground at Fontwell, Warwick and Plumpton and he did it comfortably on last two occasions; four-month absence asks a significant question but the ground has come right for him again in this hat-trick bid.

runners.comment: 101 days off; plenty suggests a brighter future over fences and that he will stay new trip
runners.name: Datsalrightcharlie
runners.spotlight: Won a four-runner maiden here (2m3f) on hurdle debut last March; beaten about 3l on all his three starts since, in handicaps over about 2m5f on last two occasions; absent 101 days but plenty about him suggests a brighter future over fences and that he will stay this trip.

runners.comment: 1-22 overall; backward steps last two outings; well handicapped if he returns to form
runners.name: Mahler Moon
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 22 races was over hurdles at Newbury (3m, good to soft) last March; runner-up twice over fences at Hereford (2m5f/3m1f, good) in November, which however were followed by two backward steps; well handicapped if he returns to form.

15:15.race_name: Weatherbys Digital Solutions Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.breeder: Mill House Stud & Mrs Kathy Stuart
runners.comment: Placed in two of her three bumpers; hurdle debut was 21l defeat at Catterick two weeks ago
runners.name: Flying Pimpernel
runners.spotlight: Placed in two of her three bumpers; embarked on her hurdles campaign with a 21l defeat at Catterick (extended 1m7f, good; 9-2) two weeks ago and is probably looking at another minor honour.

runners.comment: Unfortunate in Irish point but tailed off in a bumper; left James Hannon for Olly Murphy
runners.name: Kaylas Friend
runners.spotlight: Looked unfortunate not to collect in an Irish maiden point in November, in command when unseating at the last; tailed off, however, when 10-1 for a bumper at Thurles in December; has changed hands and left James Hannon for Olly Murphy; market may well guide.

runners.comment: Well related; promise in two bumpers; wind op since heavy defeat on hurdle debut; hood too
runners.name: Kittys Glance
runners.spotlight: Well related and showed promise in her two bumpers; 14-1 for mares' novice hurdle here (2m, good to soft) in December but raced freely and hung left on her way to a heavy defeat; had wind surgery in January and she also now sports a hood.

runners.comment: Irish point win; C&D second is far and away the best form in this; flopped last time
runners.name: Lisnamurrican
runners.spotlight: Won a soft-ground Irish point in December 2024 and, following a one-year absence, clear second to a pretty useful rival on stable/hurdle debut over C&D (soft) in December; latter is far and away the best form in this line-up but also miles better than her performance at Warwick (good to soft) on latest outing; mixed messages.

runners.comment: Significant ability in two bumpers; dam is half-sister to Champion Hurdle winner Binocular
runners.name: Pure Ocean
runners.spotlight: Showed significant ability in bumpers at Plumpton (2m2f, good to soft) and Newcastle (2m, AW) this winter; player if she builds on that and her dam is a half-sister to Champion Hurdle winner Binocular.

runners.comment: 2022 bumper form reads well; well beaten all three runs since, off 836 days before latest
runners.name: Tipperary Star
runners.spotlight: Placed in three bumpers on soft/heavy in 2022, form which reads well; however, she's been well beaten on all three starts since, absent 836 days before her run at Hereford last month; has had two wind operations, latest in October 2025; up in trip but it's hard to bank on a sufficient revival.

runners.comment: Failed to beat anyone last month when triple-figure odds for two bumpers; now tongue tied
runners.name: Ebony Ebbs
runners.spotlight: Failed to beat anyone last month when triple-figure odds for bumpers at Kempton (good to soft) and Doncaster (soft; made most); now tongue tied.

15:45.race_name: Weatherbys Design & Print Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: One of the two form picks here, but heavy defeats in handicaps on his last two outings
runners.name: Dream Diamond
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish 6yo who justified skinny odds with minimal fuss in Worcester maiden (2m, good) on stable debut in August; he's one of the two form picks on that and earlier evidence, but the heavy defeats in his two handicaps since tell a very different story.

runners.comment: Won in October and has kept his form, including on good ground; leading form claims
runners.name: Wandering Ego
runners.spotlight: Won at Stratford (2m, good to soft) in October on second hurdle start and, unlike Dream Diamond, has kept his form in his three starts since, including on good ground; leading form claims.

runners.breeder: Tommy James Eoin Banville & Lucy Norton
runners.comment: Placed in one of his Irish points but no claims on rules form; third attempt over hurdles
runners.name: Bargain Hunter
runners.spotlight: Placed in one of his Irish points but no claims on rules form; third attempt over hurdles, after which he should have a handicap mark.

runners.comment: Fair on Flat (pipped 15 days ago); sire Golden Horn has done well with plenty of jumpers
runners.name: Calvert
runners.spotlight: Just 1-18 on Flat, with mostly fair form though and he was pipped over 1m6f just 15 days ago on latest start; just as good on turf as AW; sire Golden Horn has done well with plenty of jumpers; needs a close look on hurdle debut.

runners.comment: Return to hurdles (second attempt) over C&D last Wednesday saw him beaten 52l at 300-1
runners.name: Man Of Riddles
runners.spotlight: A declining force on the Flat and his return to hurdles (second attempt) over C&D last Wednesday saw him beaten 52l at 300-1.

runners.comment: Plenty of ability before his lesser show in a third good-ground bumper in September
runners.name: Saxon Cross
runners.spotlight: Had a poor completion record in Irish points but showed plenty of ability in his first two bumpers, before a lesser show in a third good-ground bumper in September; needs a second look on debut for new yard.

runners.comment: Brother to useful hurdler Secret Squirrel; significant ability on Wincanton hurdle debut
runners.name: Secret Sniper
runners.spotlight: Placed in the first two of three bumpers; brother to useful hurdler Secret Squirrel and although his own hurdle debut at Wincanton (1m7f, good to soft; 9-1) three weeks ago showed significant ability, he needs to build on that.

runners.comment: Flat bred but his two Flat runs in Ireland last May/July weren't full of promise
runners.name: Bold Spirit
runners.spotlight: Flat bred but his two Flat runs in Ireland last May/July weren't full of promise; has changed hands and left John Joseph Murphy; new trainer had an odds-on hurdle winner last Saturday.

runners.comment: Big odds in two hurdle races recently, beaten 29l over C&D on latest
runners.name: Louie The Legend
runners.spotlight: Fair Flat winner (not as good as Calvert) and seemingly best at up to about 1m in that sphere; big odds in two hurdle races recently, beaten 29l over C&D on latest; major work to do.

runners.comment: 3rd on hurdle debut at Taunton (2m3f, heavy) was more like it; needs to build on that too
runners.name: Mariole
runners.spotlight: Close second over 1m4f (very soft) on sole start in France; tailed off in a Listed bumper at Cheltenham (7-1) on New Year's Day but third of eight on hurdle debut at Taunton (2m3f, heavy) five weeks ago was vastly better; needs to build on that but, from a top yard, it may well be possible.

runners.comment: Lost his form on Flat and hurdle/yard debut at Kempton (2m, good) did not look promising
runners.name: Wise Counsellor
runners.spotlight: Pretty useful maiden on Flat at his best (1m6f) for Andrew Balding, but lost his form in that sphere and hurdle/yard debut at Kempton (2m, good) in January did not look promising.

runners.comment: Modest ten-race maiden on Flat (stays 1m4f) and needs much better on this hurdle debut
runners.name: Argentum
runners.spotlight: Modest ten-race maiden on Flat (stays 1m4f; latest start eight days ago) who needs much better on this hurdle debut.

runners.comment: Perhaps not seen to best effect on handicap debut having gone clear with one other
runners.name: Jaffa Cake
runners.spotlight: Underwhelming since finishing second in a bumper 12 months ago and he was pulled up on his handicap debut four weeks ago (2m4f, soft) when not strong in the betting at 9-1; did go clear with one other that day so perhaps wasn't seen to best effect.

runners.comment: Presumably thought capable of better and perhaps cheekpieces can bring him on
runners.name: Star Of Diamonds
runners.spotlight: Won an Irish point two years ago; hasn't progressed under rules (including three chases but back hurdling last time) despite often being short in the betting; presumably thought capable of better and perhaps cheekpieces can bring him on.

runners.comment: Won on the AW before winning comfortably by 10l here last week; penalised
runners.name: Carlton
runners.spotlight: Won over 1m6f on the AW last month and followed up with a 10l success over 2m4f here last week (good); in the groove and might well defy the penalty.

runners.comment: Ability for Nicky Henderson and interesting to see what the new stable can do with him
runners.name: Western Harmony
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner in 2023; has yet to fulfil initial bumper promise and was pulled up a year ago on handicap debut (3m, soft; first-time cheekpieces) on final start for Nicky Henderson; interesting to see what the new stable can do with him; market can guide.

runners.comment: Three-time winner and likely contender if all the better for a wind operation
runners.name: Ikigai Star
runners.spotlight: Won in a small field off 3lb higher at Huntingdon last May (2m3f) but mostly struggled afterwards in cheekpieces and latterly in a visor; clearly a form contender if he's all the better for a wind operation.

runners.comment: Finished third on his handicap debut at Newcastle but was beaten some 23l
runners.name: Supreme Shot
runners.spotlight: Finished third on his handicap debut at Newcastle (2m1f, good to soft; 12-1) but was beaten some 23l and didn't really smack of an imminent winner that day; down 3lb.

runners.comment: Infrequent winner who struggles with consistency and Alex Chadwick has got off him
runners.name: Snapius
runners.spotlight: Infrequent winner who struggles with consistency and Alex Chadwick has got off him to partner stablemate Carlton.

runners.comment: None too consistent but shouldn't be far away if giving his true running
runners.name: Flash In The Park
runners.owner: Mt Hughes John Lawson Stephanie Kaye
runners.spotlight: None too consistent but he's a dual chase winner (2m4f/2m) and was second to the odds-on favourite in a small field last time; shouldn't be far away if giving his true running.

runners.breeder: G A E C De LOmbre
runners.comment: Has only won at Worcester; didn't run at all well in his last two races, both over fences
runners.name: Hobie
runners.spotlight: Has only won at Worcester, going back-to-back there in late summer (2m4f hurdle/2m chase); didn't run at all well in his last two races, both over fences.

runners.comment: Winning chase/yard debut in November and reportedly made a noise next time
runners.name: Livys Lad
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 6yo; made winning seasonal/stable/chase debut at Southwell in November (2m, soft) and reportedly made a noise when third to Flash In The Park off this 5lb higher mark there the following month; could be given another chance.

runners.breeder: S A R L Ecurie Lafeu
runners.comment: Hasn't won in seven years and, even at the age of 12, he tends to overrace
runners.name: Ballywood
runners.spotlight: His last win was seven years ago off a miles higher mark; finished third here last month in the new blinkers but was tailed off and, even at the age of 12, he tends to overrace.

runners.comment: Chase debut here was okay but then pulled up at Market Rasen
runners.name: Walk The Plank
runners.spotlight: Some promise switched to fences here in December but was well held and then pulled up at Market Rasen; others safer.

runners.comment: Has not progressed from his winning chase debut in April 2023; absent ten months
runners.name: Pleasure Garden
runners.spotlight: Has not progressed from his winning chase debut in April 2023 and ran poorly when last seen ten months ago.

17:15.race_name: Weatherbys Scientific Fillies' "Junior" National Hunt Flat Race (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Penalised for winning a 1m3f bumper on soft ground in France last September
runners.name: Merry Wood
runners.spotlight: Penalised for winning a 1m3f bumper on soft ground in France last September; not the easiest to assess so best to let the betting guide.

runners.comment: Well-related filly who ran well for a long way when 33-1 at Ludlow, only tiring late on
runners.name: Chocolate Cosmos
runners.spotlight: Well-related filly who ran well for a long way when 33-1 at Ludlow, only tiring late on (beaten 5l; good to soft); can improve on that.

runners.comment: Closely related to 2m7f/3m1f hurdle winner Miss Fairfax; good yard gets bumper winners
runners.name: Donwell Abbey
runners.spotlight: Closely related to 2m7f/3m1f hurdle winner Miss Fairfax; dam unraced half-sister to high-class hurdle/chase winner Carlingford Lough; respected stable has bumper winners so she needs a market check.

runners.breeder: G Garcon J Garcon & I Garcon
runners.comment: 20,000euros yearling; fifth foal; half-sister to the talented Saint Davy
runners.name: Endellion
runners.spotlight: 20,000euros yearling; fifth foal; half-sister to winners Saint Davy (point/bumper and useful 2m3f-3m hurdle), Saint Symphonie (French 2m2f chase) and Sainthilaire (point); dam French 2m2f hurdle/chase winner; yard 7-61 in bumpers recent seasons.

runners.comment: Half-sister to the same connections' useful performer Moon Chime who won bumpers
runners.name: Falconella
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to the same connections' useful performer Moon Chime who won two of his three bumpers; could be interesting; tongue-tie fitted.

runners.comment: 30,000euros foal; fifth foal; half-sister to bumper winner Linda Moon
runners.name: Georgie Too
runners.spotlight: 30,000euros foal; fifth foal; half-sister to bumper winner Linda Moon; unraced dam closely related to winners The Dutchman (smart 2m-3m2f hurdle/chase) and The Pirate's Queen (bumper/useful 2m3f hurdle); trainer, who also runs It Takes Two, has bumper winners first time out.

runners.comment: 12-1 and beaten the thick end of 20l at Fakenham a month ago (soft); needed to show more
runners.name: Golden Sanjida
runners.spotlight: 12-1 and beaten the thick end of 20l at Fakenham a month ago (soft); needed to show more.

runners.comment: Half-sister to bumper and useful 2m5f-3m hurdle/chase winner Intense Approach
runners.name: It Takes Two
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; half-sister to bumper and useful 2m5f-3m hurdle/chase winner Intense Approach; dam 11.5f-1m6f Flat (RPR 103) and useful 2m hurdle winner; market informative with the yard doubly represented.

runners.comment: 6,000euros foal; third foal; half-sister to point and bumper winner Minella Premier
runners.name: Jukella
runners.spotlight: 6,000euros foal; third foal; half-sister to point and bumper winner Minella Premier; dam well beaten in a bumper, sister to 2m5f-2m7f hurdle winner Ellens Way; betting often a good guide with newcomers from this yard.

runners.comment: Fifth foal; half-sister to bumper winner Killarney Mountain; dam 11.6f-1m5f winner
runners.name: Lissahane Lass
runners.spotlight: Fifth foal; half-sister to bumper winner Killarney Mountain; dam 11.6f-1m5f winner; yard 1-4 in bumpers recent seasons.

runners.comment: 30,000euros 3yo; second foal out of a 3m/3m1f hurdle winner
runners.name: Look This Way
runners.spotlight: 30,000euros 3yo; second foal out of a 3m/3m1f hurdle winner from the family of smart chaser Strong Flow; Flat-geared yard has had one bumper runner in recent seasons (unplaced).

runners.comment: 10,000euros foal; first foal; dam 2m7f-3m2f hurdle/chase winner
runners.name: Milly Ocean
runners.spotlight: 10,000euros foal; first foal; dam 2m7f-3m2f hurdle/chase winner, sister to 2m-2m5f hurdle winner Milan Of Crystal; trainer always respected in races of this nature.

runners.comment: Trainer/jockey combination had a 13-2 bumper newcomer win last week
runners.name: Orixa
runners.spotlight: £25,000 3yo; half-sister to winners Forest Blaze (2m4f hurdle), Jante Law (2m hurdle), Luna Dora (2m hurdle) and Pixie Loc (bumper); dam useful 2m-2m5f hurdle/chase winner; trainer an impressive 6-29 in bumpers recent seasons and three bumper winners this campaign included a newcomer last week who was ridden by Danny McMenamin (went off 13-2).

runners.comment: Beaten a long way on good to soft here and on soft at Fakenham; very opposable
runners.name: Potters Honour
runners.spotlight: Beaten a long way on good to soft here and on soft at Fakenham; very opposable.

runners.comment: 50,000euros 3yo; seventh foal; sister to 2m4f hurdle winner Dramatic Encore
runners.name: St Marys Wantage
runners.spotlight: 50,000euros 3yo; seventh foal; sister to 2m4f hurdle winner Dramatic Encore; dam useful bumper/2m hurdle winner; she's of obvious interest given that Nicky Henderson trains her.

14:00.race_name: Charity Partner We Are Farming Minds Handicap Chase

runners.comment: First run over fences was encouraging but not the latest; may need good ground
runners.name: Ballyfinn
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced maiden who is having only a third run over fences; shaped well in the first after a long absence, over 3m1f at Plumpton (all runs under rules on good ground); however, well beaten last time and had another break since.

runners.comment: Up 6lb, so on a career-high mark, but he's probably the safest option after his Exeter win
runners.name: Kingcormac
runners.spotlight: Up there with his best form when scoring for a third time over fences at Exeter (2m3f, good to soft) where he was 6l to the good at the line; up 6lb, so on a career-high mark, but he's probably the safest option.

runners.comment: Two good runs after a wind operation but drying conditions might not be favourable
runners.name: Kitsilano
runners.spotlight: The ground was heavy for his hurdle win in Ireland (2m3f) and when scoring by 8l at Leicester last month (2m), opening his chase account after wind surgery; ran okay off this 7lb higher mark at Plumpton (soft) latest but drying conditions might not be favourable.

runners.comment: Dubious form when winning in December; tailed off in four subsequent runs
runners.name: Zacony Rebel
runners.spotlight: Dubious form when winning off 5lb higher at Huntingdon in December (2m7f, soft) and tailed off in his four subsequent runs; opposable.

runners.comment: Has placed form that entitles him to consideration and has changed stables
runners.name: Kapamazov
runners.spotlight: 20 defeats under rules include 12 over fences; has placed form that entitles him to consideration and a change of stables may perk him up; trip/ground should be fine.

runners.comment: Good mark even from out of the handicap but he's a risky proposition at the minute
runners.name: Greenways
runners.spotlight: Drying conditions will be in his favour but this 7yo has been struggling for a while now on all sorts of surfaces; potentially on a good mark even from out of the handicap but he's a risky proposition at the minute.

runners.comment: Wasn't in much form when last seen, as the two thirds were remote
runners.name: Gorcombe Moonshine
runners.spotlight: 1-32 under rules, the win coming over fences in 2023 (2m2f, soft); wasn't in much form when last seen, as the two thirds were remote; 5lb out of the weights this time.

14:30.race_name: Hereford Bull Trail Launch 2026 Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Consistent and won't mind this drier surface; considered for his in-form stable
runners.name: Dwight K Schrute
runners.spotlight: No match for an in-form winner last time at Sedgefield (3m3f, soft; second run in cheekpieces) but he's consistent and won't mind this drier surface; considered for his in-form stable.

runners.comment: In poor form but too well handicapped to rule out and blinkers go on for cheekpieces
runners.name: Knockanore
runners.spotlight: Hasn't run a race of note since winning last season's 4m1f Eider Chase at Newcastle, in which his struggles continued last time out (tailed off or pulled up over hurdles prior to that); too well handicapped to rule out and blinkers go on for cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Inconsistent but he's on a good mark should blinkers trigger something
runners.name: Kintail
runners.spotlight: Ex-Nicky Henderson inmate who struggles with consistency; disappointing in his two runs for this yard but he's on a good mark should blinkers trigger something (he ran one good race when cheekpieces were tried).

runners.comment: Up the weights for his win here in December but he had dropped to a fair mark
runners.name: Despereaux
runners.spotlight: Had been struggling but has steadily got himself back on track and prevailed narrowly over C&D in December on latest appearance; 6lb higher for this and connections claimed another 7lb last time through Isabelle Ryder, but he had dropped to a fair mark anyway.

runners.comment: Out of form but what could help is getting away from soft ground
runners.name: Vee Dancer
runners.owner: K P Marsh Plastering & Interiors Ltd
runners.spotlight: An 11yo now and has pulled up in two hurdle races and a chase since returning from a lengthy break; what could help is getting away from soft ground, as good seems his preference.

runners.comment: Hurdle/chase winner; on a perfectly good mark if he can bounce back to form
runners.name: DJo Dela Barriere
runners.spotlight: Won a 3m handicap hurdle at Ffos Las (good) before returning to fences at Ludlow (3m, good) where he finished alone; form has dipped since, over fences and hurdles; on a perfectly good mark if he can bounce back to form.

runners.comment: In form but the concern is this trip as he's unraced beyond an extended 2m5f
runners.name: Don Rafael
runners.spotlight: Fortunate to register a second 2m3f win here in November but has held his form since and he clearly likes it here; the concern is this trip as he's unraced beyond an extended 2m5f.

15:00.race_name: Enjoy Coneleys Fun Fair This March Mares' Novices' Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Stuck on for second on her handicap debut over 2m5f here a month ago; can run well
runners.name: Lydeard Girl
runners.spotlight: Stuck on for second on her handicap debut over 2m5f here a month ago (heavy) and showed promise on good ground in her qualifying races; likely to run well.

runners.comment: Handicaps should see her in a better light; any market confidence would be worth noting
runners.name: Shanagolden Girl
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in an Irish point; hasn't offered a lot under rules (2m-2m3f) but handicaps should see her in a better light; any market confidence would be worth noting.

runners.comment: She's been well beaten thus far but now goes into handicaps for a much respected yard
runners.name: Independent Lady
runners.spotlight: Similar profile to Shanagolden Girl in that she's been well beaten thus far (1m7f-2m3f) but now goes into handicaps for a much respected yard; the market should be informative.

runners.comment: Yet to win over hurdles but has run many a good race in handicaps
runners.name: After Many Days
runners.spotlight: Yet to win over hurdles but has run many a good race in handicaps and beat all bar a well-treated rival last time at Huntingdon (2m3f, heavy); has gone well here before on good ground; every chance.

runners.comment: Beaten 12l in a novice here last time; showed plenty of bumper promise on good ground
runners.name: Moorsbrook
runners.spotlight: Had three runs following a long absence and the latest was the best, when beaten 12l in a 2m novice here on heavy ground; now into a handicap and might yet tap into the distinct promise she showed in bumpers (on good); has always sported a hood.

runners.comment: Off since September; can be competitive off this mark and drying going would aid her cause
runners.name: Jlow
runners.spotlight: Has a bit to prove from a wellbeing perspective as she was tailed off on the Flat when last sighted in September; however, this 16-race maiden (under both codes) can be competitive off this mark and drying ground would aid her cause.

runners.comment: Much better last time but has ground to make up on the second After Many Days
runners.name: Getarose
runners.spotlight: Tailed off in her first four handicaps but ran a lot better to be fourth at Huntingdon a month ago (2m3f, heavy); however, she has ground to make up on the second After Many Days.

runners.comment: The odd piece of form is worth noting and she has never been lower in the weights
runners.name: Make Sunshine
runners.spotlight: 18-race maiden with a Flat background; the odd piece of form is worth noting and she has never been lower in the weights, but she's suffered four non-completions on the bounce (fell midrace on chase debut latest); a bit risky in the new hood (replacing tongue-tie).

runners.comment: Has shown glimpses of ability but not in her latest two races, after an absence
runners.name: Little Lady Lucy
runners.spotlight: Has shown glimpses of ability but not in her latest two races, after an absence; can only be watched for now.

15:30.race_name: Spa Motors Hereford Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Has twice come up shy under a penalty but those were improved efforts
runners.name: Silver Hill
runners.spotlight: Bumper/novice winner; has twice come up shy under a penalty but those were improved efforts and he was clear of the rest behind a good sort last time at Newcastle (2m4f, good to soft); the one to beat.

runners.comment: Will to find need more, and probably plenty more, if he's to trouble Silver Hill
runners.name: Argento Royale
runners.spotlight: Third in two points and filled the same position when not beaten far at Newcastle (2m1f, good to soft; first run in a tongue-tie); will need to find more, and probably plenty more, if he's to trouble Silver Hill.

runners.comment: Best run according to Topspeed and RPRs when beaten about 8l here last time
runners.name: Guardami Ancora
runners.spotlight: Twice runner-up and although beaten further (about 8l) over 2m here last time, that was his best run according to Topspeed and RPRs; shouldn't be far away in a race of this nature; bred for this far.

runners.comment: Would probably have won his latest point but for unseating; bought for £25,000
runners.name: Itsjustthewayiam
runners.spotlight: Failed to complete in three Irish points but looked set to collect when unseating late on in the latest; bought for £25,000.

runners.comment: Raced on only soft/heavy as a jumper and these conditions should suit him better
runners.name: Kingdom Of Stars
runners.spotlight: Fair Flat performer who was bought for 32,000gns; at least completed when hooded here last month but he was well beaten; has raced only on soft/heavy as a jumper and these conditions should suit him better.

runners.comment: Good-ground winner; she'll need her best form yet now going in against male opposition
runners.name: No Tricks At All
runners.owner: M V Magnier Mrs P Shanahan & Dash Grange Stud
runners.spotlight: 18-1 winner of a good-ground novice for mares at Worcester in October; soft ground perhaps to blame for her no-show at Market Rasen (winner smart) but she'll need her best form yet now going in against male opposition.

runners.comment: Bought for £10,000 after narrowly winning what was probably a modest Irish point
runners.name: Yellow Warning
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Brian Davies
runners.spotlight: Bought for £10,000 after narrowly winning what was probably a modest Irish point (yielding to soft) in October.

16:00.race_name: Remembering Brian Davies And Volcano Novices' Handicap Chase

runners.comment: Lightly raced 6yo who may have had an excuse last time; could bounce back in new headgear
runners.name: Forsa Bay
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 6yo who reappeared with a fair third on chase debut at Market Rasen (2m3f, good to soft) in December; disappointing when pulled up at Sedgefield last month but he may have not have handled the tacky ground and he's a player if he can bounce back; first-time visor.

runners.comment: Back to winning mark but record is now 1-17 and he needs a major revival back over fences
runners.name: LEmpire Vert
runners.owner: E A R Morgans C A Pengelly G Wilson
runners.spotlight: Defied this mark in a handicap chase at Ludlow (2m, good) in November but has struggled since, including over hurdles here (2m4f, good) 11 days ago; record is now 1-17 and he needs a major revival back over fences.

runners.comment: Unexposed chaser who got back on track with a win at Bangor; big player again up 5lb
runners.name: Just Aidan
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdle winner who made it second time lucky over fences when beating seven rivals in a Bangor handicap (2m2f, soft) last month; up 5lb but he turned things around with that comfortable success and should have more to offer in this sphere; key player.

runners.comment: Well held in last two hurdle runs and has something to prove on chase debut
runners.name: No Guarantee
runners.spotlight: Struck form with two 2m hurdle wins in December (Ludlow claimer and Hereford handicap) but three lesser efforts have followed, including a well-held third of five at Ludlow last month; still 4lb higher than for his last success and something to prove on this switch to chasing; reapplied cheekpieces replace a visor.

runners.comment: Unexposed 6yo but he needs a transformation on chase/handicap debut
runners.name: Richforadaay
runners.spotlight: Failed to complete in three of his four points and tailed off in three hurdle runs at Wincanton (1m7f, soft/heavy) this year; still early days and now goes handicapping but he needs a transformation on chase/handicap debut.

runners.comment: Has struggled in four runs over hurdles and she needs improvement on chase debut
runners.name: Glancing Back
runners.owner: Emma Bishop Racing Club & Mrs Mj Arnold
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 6yo but she's struggled in her four runs over hurdles, tailed off on recent handicap debut at Huntingdon (2m, good to soft; 15-2); probably did too much too soon in that race but she needs improvement on this switch to fences.

runners.comment: Struggled in last two starts but has claims on her Sedgefield win in November
runners.name: Formel Park
runners.spotlight: Hard to predict and has struggled over fences and hurdles in last two runs, but she scored in this sphere at Sedgefield (about 2m, soft) in November; has possibilities if she can recapture that form and she's still unexposed as a chaser.

runners.comment: 0-8 under rules and has struggled in handicap chases on last three runs; lots to prove
runners.name: The Brickey Ranger
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner but 0-8 under rules and struggled in handicap chases on last three runs; mark continues to fall but he was pulled up at Leicester three weeks ago and has lots to prove on this drop to 2m; cheekpieces removed.

16:30.race_name: Coneleys Theme Park Fun Fair Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Well held on handicap debut at Chepstow but he's 2-2 at Hereford and still has potential
runners.name: Vol Royale
runners.spotlight: Made all in maiden/novice events over 2m here (good to soft/soft) in December and January; well held on handicap debut at Chepstow last month but that was a Class 3 contest and this lightly raced 6yo still has potential; not ruled out dropped back in grade and he's bred to stay this far.

runners.comment: Showed promise in Ireland last year and needs a close look on handicap/stable debut
runners.name: Top Coeur
runners.spotlight: Showed promise in three runs for Gavin Cromwell last year, including when third of 13 in a Thurles maiden (2m, yielding) in December; out of a half-sister to three French hurdle winners and she needs a close look on handicap/stable debut.

runners.comment: Chase winner but he's 0-11 over hurdles and has struggled in his last two runs
runners.name: Beau Quali
runners.spotlight: Won over fences at Warwick (2m4f, good) for Dan Skelton in October and close second over hurdles at Southwell (2m4f, soft) the following month; looks interesting on that form but he's lost his way in last two runs and needs to get back on track; stablemate of Top Coeur.

runners.breeder: E A R L Haras Du Mondant & J Le Roux
runners.comment: Fair third at Chepstow latest and has possibilities back up in trip and down in grade
runners.name: Castelfort
runners.spotlight: Triple hurdle winner at 2m on testing ground but effective over this far; didn't take to chasing in the autumn (two attempts) but he's shown promise since returned to hurdling, including when third at Chepstow (2m, soft) last month; continues to edge down the weights and has possibilities back up in trip and down in grade.

runners.comment: Had wind surgery in December but he needs a big turnaround back over hurdles
runners.name: Wolf Moon
runners.spotlight: Dual 2m novice hurdle winner last season but well beaten (albeit in competitive race) on handicap debut in April and he's also struggled in two chase runs this winter; still lightly raced and now returns after wind surgery but he needs a big turnaround back over hurdles.

runners.comment: Placed in all three hurdle runs and he's an interesting contender on handicap debut
runners.name: Emerald Breeze
runners.spotlight: Out of an unraced sister to three jumps winners including Ollie Magern (high-class 2m5f-3m1f hurdle/chase); unexposed 6yo who has finished placed in his three hurdle runs, including a close second at Ffos Las (2m, heavy) on his penultimate run; should have more to offer in this sphere and he's an interesting contender upped in trip on handicap debut.

runners.comment: Still has low mileage but he has some questions to answer and others are preferred
runners.name: Fight My Fire
runners.spotlight: Won a Fontwell maiden (2m2f, good to soft) in October but he's not gone on from that and was pulled up in a Taunton handicap (2m3f, good) in January; still has low mileage but some questions to answer and others are preferred.

runners.comment: Back from long absence with an encouraging third on handicap debut at Newbury; in the mix
runners.name: El Curamach
runners.spotlight: Odds-on winner of a Warwick maiden (2m, good) in May 2024 and he returned after a long absence with an encouraging third on handicap debut at Newbury (2m4f, good to soft) last month; that was behind a major improver and he's a player if he can build on that.

17:00.race_name: Richard Layton Charity Day 16th April Handicap Chase

runners.comment: Hurdle winner but he's struggled in last two chase runs and is untried at this trip
runners.name: The Magus
runners.spotlight: Won handicap hurdle debut at Chepstow (2m3f, good) at end of last season; launched chasing career with two thirds in the autumn (2m5f/2m7f, good) but he's struggled in his last two runs; has quite a bit to prove again and is untried at this trip.

runners.comment: His last win was in 2023 and he was out of sorts last year; 114 days off; opposable
runners.name: Atlanta Brave
runners.spotlight: Thrown in on his old form but last win was in January 2023 and he was out of sorts over fences and hurdles last year; has lots to prove back from a break and he's failed to complete in his last three chase runs.

runners.breeder: R Simon D G Powell Et Al
runners.comment: Made a respectable chase debut when runner-up over C&D last month; respected off 2lb lower
runners.name: Johnny Boy
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent eight-race maiden but he's on a reduced mark and made a respectable chase debut when runner-up over C&D (heavy) last month; made some mistakes and was no match for the winner but should benefit from that experience and this return to quicker ground should be fine; respected.

runners.comment: Lightly raced 6yo but he was disappointing last time and is untried beyond 2m5f
runners.name: Cornish Comedy
runners.spotlight: Made a promising start over fences when runner-up here (2m5f, good to soft) in December but he flopped when favourite at Warwick (2m4f) later that month; still has low mileage but he's been up and down so far and needs to bounce back at this new trip.

runners.comment: On a dangerous mark but he's been well held in last five runs and others are preferred
runners.name: Edgewell
runners.spotlight: Chase and dual hurdle winner, all at around 3m on good and good to soft ground; well handicapped on his close fourth at Windsor in November but he's been well held in five subsequent runs, including when back over hurdles at Catterick last time; losing run is now up to 11 and others are preferred.

runners.comment: Lightly raced 6yo but he needs a transformation after wind surgery; tongue-tie added
runners.name: Tongaknoxie
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 6yo but he's not shown a great deal and was pulled up on chase debut over C&D (good to soft) in January; had wind surgery since but he needs a transformation after a short break; tongue-tie added.

runners.comment: On reduced mark; plenty to prove on first run since October; usual tongue-tie reinstated
runners.name: Wild Nephin
runners.owner: K P Marsh Plastering & Interiors Ltd
runners.spotlight: Point/hurdle winner who is lightly raced over fences but was out of sorts in the second half of last year, tailed off in October last time; continues to drop down the weights but has plenty to prove back up in trip on his return; usual tongue-tie (absent last time) is reinstated.

runners.breeder: S C E A De La Metairie
runners.comment: Triple chase winner who may have needed last month's run after six months off; in the mix
runners.name: Prince Cleni
runners.spotlight: All three chase wins have come over 3m at Southwell (good/soft) and latest was off 2lb higher last January; well held at Southwell last month but he may have needed that run after six months off and he's a player if he can get back near best.

runners.comment: Third at Bangor (2m1f) latest but this is a very different test and he's still a maiden
runners.name: Daring Plan
runners.owner: Miss Jane Edgar & D V Gardner
runners.spotlight: 8yo with overall record of 0-21; well treated on his close third at Fontwell (2m3f, good) last spring but he's not come close to that form since; ran respectably at Bangor (2m1f, soft) last month but this is a very different test and he comes with risks attached on this big step back up in trip.

16:55.race_name: Virgin Bet/EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Ridden from the front in cheekpieces last three starts but proved vulnerable
runners.name: Adalida
runners.spotlight: Ridden from the front in cheekpieces last three starts but proved vulnerable in the closing stages; others make more appeal.

runners.comment: The one to beat with this track likely to suit better than Lingfield
runners.name: Moonshine
runners.spotlight: Beaten into second at 2-5 and evens since catching the eye on Newbury debut (finished third) but she was unlucky not to win at Lingfield last month following 201 days off; this track should give her more time to find her stride; the one to beat.

runners.comment: Finished weakly over 7f last time but has a shout on previous two efforts over this trip
runners.name: Queen Sana
runners.spotlight: Finished weakly over 7f last time but has a shout on previous two efforts over this trip; tackles Polytrack for the first time.

runners.comment: Very pleasing debut here; major claims if coping with dropping back a furlong
runners.name: Archers Grace
runners.owner: Fred Archer Racing - Wheel Of Fortune II
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to two smart operators for this yard in Archer's Dream and Hickory; very pleasing debut when splitting market leaders, who had the benefit of experience, on debut over 7f here in October; major claims if coping with dropping back a furlong.

runners.comment: Trainer over 20% with 3yos in AW maidens/novices last five years; market useful
runners.name: Thai Princess
runners.spotlight: By Bangkok; 5,000gns foal; first foal; dam 5f/6f winner (RPR 83); trainer over 20% with 3yos in AW maidens/novices last five years; market useful.

17:30.race_name: Virgin Bet Daily Price Boosts Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.comment: No immediate promise when sent off 14-1 for debut at Chelmsford 11 days ago (7f)
runners.name: Bumaan
runners.spotlight: No immediate promise when sent off 14-1 for debut at Chelmsford 11 days ago (7f); surely one for further down the line.

runners.comment: Bumped into one on debut and has major claims of going one better
runners.name: El Nay
runners.spotlight: Found just an Amo Racing colt who is seemingly held in high regard (he was sent off odds on and holds entries in the English and Irish Guineas) just too strong on debut at Lingfield last month (1m; SP 100-30; pair over 7l clear); major claims of going one better.

runners.comment: Fair third on debut; much more is needed and he wouldn't want to hang left around here
runners.name: Im Just Ken
runners.spotlight: Fair third of five on debut at Wolverhampton last week (7f) but much more is needed and he wouldn't want to hang left around here; tongue-tie retained.

runners.comment: Trailed in last on debut and didn't achieve much more when behind I'm Just Ken last week
runners.name: Kakirra
runners.spotlight: Hooded both starts at Wolverhampton over 7f; trailed in last on debut in February and didn't achieve much more when behind I'm Just Ken last week.

runners.comment: 77,000euros yearling; the sole newcomer and he has a pretty high standard to aim at
runners.name: Kenergy
runners.spotlight: 77,000euros yearling; 11th foal; brother to French 1m1f-1m3f winner Veronesi (RPR 113), half-brother to two more French winners (one struck on AW/in Listed company; 101); dam maiden (64); the sole newcomer and he has a pretty high standard to aim at; already gelded.

runners.comment: Improved with each start last year (in RPR terms); sets the standard on AW debut
runners.name: New Monarch
runners.spotlight: Improved with each start last year (in RPR terms), culminating in excellent fourth in valuable sales race at the Curragh (7f); the winner of that contest won a Group 3 next time, the second went on to land a Local Group 2 in Qatar and the third was sent off 100-30 for the Fillies' Mile on her next outing; sets the standard on AW debut; trainer/jockey took both divisions of this in 2025.

runners.comment: Eyecatching debut was 276 days ago; gelded since and new trip should help
runners.name: Spirit Of Saxony
runners.spotlight: Ran green but finished well for third on debut at Salisbury last June (6f; 12-1); that contest has worked out well, he's been gelded since and moving up in trip should help.

runners.comment: 200-1 last of eight on debut at Lingfield ten weeks ago (1m); can't consider
runners.name: Crimson Dawn
runners.owner: Ben Pay And Carter Roofing Solutions Ltd
runners.spotlight: 200-1 last of eight on debut at Lingfield ten weeks ago (1m); can't consider; tongue-tie goes on.

18:00.race_name: Virgin Bet A Good Bet Handicap

runners.comment: Narrow PB last time; return to 7f a plus and has reasonable claims of going one better
runners.name: Ecclefechan
runners.spotlight: Just about a PB when going down by a neck over 6f at Lingfield last time (well backed); return to 7f looks a good move and he has reasonable claims of going one better off 1lb higher, particularly if gelding operation has the desired effect.

runners.comment: Different proposition when switched to nurseries; highly likely has more to offer
runners.name: Kilkenny Warrior
runners.spotlight: Different proposition when switched to nurseries last year, winning comfortably at Southwell (6f) and Lingfield (7f) under Finley Marsh; highly likely has more to offer at three; trainer took a division of this in 2025.

runners.comment: Last race perhaps came too soon; could bounce back, with real hope for AW on breeding
runners.name: French Affair
runners.spotlight: Very narrow win on nursery debut at Newbury (6f) then twice highly competitive (6f/7f); last race perhaps came too soon; could bounce back, with real hope for AW on breeding.

runners.comment: Opening mark looks fair and yard does well with runners following wind surgery
runners.name: Acclaimed Freedom
runners.owner: J Sarkar D Sarkar O Sarkar & D Sarkar
runners.spotlight: Only had to do what he did at Ascot on debut (6f; fourth of five) to open his account over this trip at Chelmsford last time; has undergone wind surgery since (yard 4-11 with horses running for the first time following such a procedure) and he enters handicaps off what looks a fair mark.

runners.comment: Three ready wins in handicap company; can't be discounted if taking to this place
runners.name: Hardstyle
runners.spotlight: Six handicap starts have yielded three ready wins and he quickly settled matters when push came to shove at Wolverhampton 15 days ago; 6lb higher this evening but can't be discounted if he takes to this place.

runners.comment: Did well at two and has C&D experience, but suspect others are open to more improvement
runners.name: Dublin Bay
runners.spotlight: Heavily backed when beating three rivals on nursery debut at Ffos Las last year and duly followed up at Doncaster (both 6f); good third over C&D when last seen but suspect others are open to more improvement; cheekpieces quickly discarded.

runners.comment: Went backwards in nurseries and others appeal more on AW debut
runners.name: Eyes Front
runners.spotlight: Two good seconds in maiden company (both 7f) but went backwards in nurseries, finishing two places and over 4l behind a slightly disappointing French Affair last time; others appeal more on AW debut.

runners.comment: Overcame widest stall to open account latest; major claims up 3lb with Oisin Murphy booked
runners.name: Lion Of Mali
runners.spotlight: Went down by a nose on sole nursery start at Newcastle last year and overcame widest stall to go one better at Wolverhampton 40 days ago (both 7f; gelded in between); major claims up 3lb with Oisin Murphy booked.

18:30.race_name: Virgin Bet Supports Safe Gambling Handicap

runners.comment: Bids to win this race for the fourth time and make it 6-6 under James Doyle; poor latest
runners.name: Mount Athos
runners.spotlight: James Doyle is 5-5 on him, three of those successes coming in this race (2023, 2024 and 2025); he's 2lb lower than last year but weakened into last place when back in a handicap over track and trip ten weeks ago.

runners.comment: Ran Sarab Star pretty close on debut for Dylan Cunha; starts out for another new yard here
runners.name: Serengeti
runners.spotlight: Dual winner (one Polytrack) over this trip for Aidan O'Brien; gave Sarab Star much the most to think about on first start for Dylan Cunha at Wolverhampton in November (7f) then not quite so effective over a furlong further on either outing since; starts out for another new yard (same owner) this evening.

runners.comment: Others may be better treated on this return to action
runners.name: Golden Mind
runners.spotlight: First of three 2025 successes came here and was last seen beating 21 rivals to win at Doncaster; a useful 7lb was taken off on that occasion and others may be better treated here.

runners.comment: Bids to make it 5-9 on AW but has never run here
runners.name: Apiarist
runners.spotlight: Beat very good yardstick in Popmaster for fourth AW win from just eight tries at Lingfield 19 days ago (1m; ridden by Jack Callan for the first time); up just 3lb, and no issue with this shorter trip, but he's never been to Kempton and trainer is just 1-14 here last five years.

runners.comment: 121 last year; looks set to make an even better 4yo and prove tough to beat
runners.name: Sarab Star
runners.spotlight: Ridden forward and improved each of his three starts last year, achieving a first and second over C&D before seeing off Serengeti at Wolverhampton (also 7f); looks set to make an even better 4yo and prove tough to beat.

runners.comment: Just a fair return/AW debut over C&D three weeks ago and more is needed
runners.name: God Of War
runners.spotlight: Doubled his tally at Sandown last August (7f) then pulled his chance away at Doncaster; just a fair return/AW debut over C&D three weeks ago and more is needed.

runners.comment: Has a few things to recommend him but this may not be run to suit
runners.name: Tiger Crusade
runners.spotlight: Luke Morris gets on well with him (form figures together read 3315421) and he'll appreciate returning to 7f having finished five places behind Apiarist over 1m at Lingfield 19 days ago; wouldn't want a tactical affair, though.

19:00.race_name: Virgin Bet Fives Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: Major claims of extending unbeaten record under Rossa Ryan to three
runners.name: Final Night
runners.spotlight: Took form to new level of late, winning back-to-back C&D contests before this mark didn't look beyond him at Newcastle (went down by less than a length in a 0-85); major claims of extending unbeaten record under Rossa Ryan to three.

runners.comment: Maiden win came over this trip and beat the 'right' horse over 1m2f last time
runners.name: Sea Founder
runners.spotlight: Won a 1m Windsor maiden last April; big step up to 1m4f didn't work at Wolverhampton in January but he got the better of King's Hand, who runs in the finale, over the intermediate trip of 1m2f at Lingfield last time; up 3lb.

runners.comment: Draw for this prominent racer could have been kinder but solid otherwise
runners.name: Rey De La Batalla
runners.spotlight: Seems equally effective over 7f or 1m; back on a mark he can win off and was noted doing some nice late work in race he'd won the previous year over the shorter trip of 7f last time; draw for this prominent racer could have been kinder.

runners.comment: Made the track just once since turning four and was well held
runners.name: Caph Star
runners.spotlight: Won a novice over C&D for Roger Varian in August 2022, but not seen again until well held on sole start for Gordon Treacy/handicap debut back here in December (gelded in the meantime); 22-1 when refusing to enter the stalls subsequently and has changed hands again since; two pieces of headgear introduced.

runners.comment: Could show up well for a long way having been gifted the rail draw
runners.name: Jazzy Baby
runners.spotlight: All runs over 1m; landed course maiden under Billy Loughnane in January then acquitted herself quite well on handicap debut five weeks ago (also here; couldn't sustain effort); could show up well for a long way having been gifted the rail draw.

runners.comment: Knocking on the door but draw could have been kinder for this return to action
runners.name: The Hare Rail
runners.owner: Mrs Muriel Forward & Dr G C Forward
runners.spotlight: Yet to win but has managed four seconds and wasn't beaten far into third/fourth back on AW and wearing cheekpieces on last two starts; draw could have been kinder for this return to action; nearly half of Tom Marquand's 31 rides for the yard in the last five years have finished in the first three.

runners.comment: Form figures in course handicaps read 1133; widest draw a blow
runners.name: Atmosphere
runners.spotlight: Form figures in course handicaps read 1133 and those recent third places don't signal he's handicapped out of this; widest draw is a blow, though.

runners.comment: Frustrating run of seconds; player if able to tuck in from a wide draw
runners.name: Arantes Nascimento
runners.spotlight: Only fifth to Final Night when back from a break over C&D in December but has managed second on all four starts since (7f); player if able to tuck in from a wide draw.

runners.comment: Beaten a long way all four starts for this yard, last two following wind surgery
runners.name: McKenna
runners.spotlight: Beaten a long way all four starts for this yard, last two following wind surgery; headgear (blinkers, worn alone for the first time) returns.

runners.comment: Folly to discount entirely given he popped up again here in January
runners.name: Billy Mill
runners.spotlight: Popped up here in January, when returning from nearly five months off, and latest effort at Wolverhampton, where he was asked to go beyond 1m for the first time, wasn't bad; folly to discount entirely.

runners.comment: Lurks on a dangerous mark but Final Night looks a safer option for John Butler fans
runners.name: Rhythm N Rock
runners.spotlight: Gamble went astray, but only just, over C&D in December; not so effective over further at Wolverhampton since but he lurks on a dangerous mark; Final Night looks a safer option for John Butler fans.

runners.comment: Down the field in two C&D runs for this yard; Jack Mitchell returns to the saddle
runners.name: Midnights Dream
runners.spotlight: Down the field in two C&D runs for this yard; Jack Mitchell, who won on him when he was with Roger Varian, returns to the saddle.

runners.comment: Breakthrough win came over C&D in November (28-1); follow up possible
runners.name: Valentine Boy
runners.spotlight: Well ridden by Jack Dace when off the mark at the sixth attempt over C&D in November (28-1); highly likely has a bit more to offer, is up just 3lb and is drawn well; not discounted.

runners.comment: Down the field over C&D last time and losing run continues, but in good form previously
runners.name: Amazonian Dream
runners.spotlight: Beaten 15 times since his last win (C&D in December 2024) and down the field over C&D four weeks ago; however, he ran well to be placed on both starts immediately prior to last time; in the mix if bouncing back.

runners.comment: His form has deteriorated but this C&D winner is not ruled out off a reduced mark
runners.name: Al Barez
runners.spotlight: His form has deteriorated and he was underwhelming over C&D four weeks ago; however, prior to that he was a close fourth over C&D after a break and this C&D winner is not ruled out off a reduced mark.

runners.comment: 0-4 here but 2l fourth over C&D three weeks ago and might not be far away
runners.name: Invincible Speed
runners.spotlight: Won at Lingfield (6f, Polytrack) in January; 0-4 here but kept on for 2l fourth of seven over C&D last month and might not be far away.

runners.comment: Kempton brings out the best in him; close second over C&D last time; very solid claims
runners.name: Serenity Dream
runners.spotlight: Made it 2-3 here when winning over C&D in January and he went close over C&D three weeks ago when back at Kempton; very solid claims.

runners.comment: Two-time C&D winner; tumbling down the weights but for good reason
runners.name: Media Shooter
runners.spotlight: Three-time AW winner, two of them over C&D, and he's tumbling down the weights; one to keep an eye on in the betting but he's struggled to get competitive since December; major turnaround needed in a switch of headgear.

runners.comment: Close second over C&D in January; needs to better his latest effort here but it's possible
runners.name: Em Four
runners.spotlight: Won at Chelmsford in January and close second over this C&D later that month; 2l fifth of seven over C&D last time when jockey dropped hands and he lost fourth to Invincible Speed in the final strides; needs to better that latest run but he's capable of doing so judged on this year's peak efforts.

runners.comment: Hefty absence to defy but the handicapper has given this two-time C&D winner a chance
runners.name: Brazen Idol
runners.spotlight: This is his first run since April 2024 and it remains to be seen how much ability he retains; however, the handicapper has given this two-time C&D winner a chance, and he's not ruled out on his first run for John Ryan (has left John Butler); watch the betting.

runners.comment: Returns from absence but sprinting might suit this lightly raced 5yo; monitor the betting
runners.name: Oberon Hill
runners.spotlight: Displayed some promise for Jedd O'Keeffe over 7f/1m in the first part of last year, shaping as though he might be suited by sprinting; sold for £12,000 last May and makes stable debut after an absence, but it will be interesting to see how this very lightly raced 5yo goes in the betting.

20:00.race_name: Virgin Bet Handicap (London Middle Distance Series Qualifier) (Div I)

runners.comment: Probably best watched on yard debut given what we saw last time
runners.name: Wood Whisperer
runners.spotlight: Improver in maiden/novice company but couldn't land a blow when nibbled at on handicap debut at Bath last time; hood, which was left off there, returns; probably best watched starting out for Charlie Pike (has left Paul Attwater).

runners.comment: Particularly disappointing on handicap debut; enough to prove back over further
runners.name: Far And Above
runners.spotlight: Ran okay first two starts (second time here) but handicap debut at Southwell last month was particularly disappointing (sent off 40-1); enough to prove back over further.

runners.comment: Key player off same mark as when going down by a length, with 4l back to the third, latest
runners.name: Tetsworth
runners.spotlight: Beaten just over a length on final start for Julie Camacho in October (1m2f); acquitted himself quite well on hurdle/stable debut at Kempton just after Christmas then found just one too good in amateur riders' race at Chelmsford (1m2f; 4l back to the third); key player off same mark.

runners.comment: 16th-time lucky when stepped up to 1m2f latest (did well to win)
runners.name: Joseph
runners.spotlight: Overcame major early setback to break through at 16th time of asking in apprentice race under Donagh Murphy at Lingfield last month (first crack at 1m2f having raced mainly over 1m); 3lb rise could be defied.

runners.comment: Not certain to back up close second on handicap debut given he was seen to advantage there
runners.name: Imperial Decision
runners.spotlight: Uncompetitive in novice/maiden company; clearly aided by being held up in a strongly run race on handicap debut in amateur riders' race at Lingfield last month (1m4f; 25-1) but that nose-second was still encouraging; not certain to back it up off 2lb higher.

runners.comment: Percentage call is to oppose, particularly given poor course form
runners.name: Seraphic
runners.spotlight: Can flatter to deceive, like when trading at 11-10 in-running before giving best to Enthused at Southwell two runs ago having beaten him at Chelmsford in January; ran better than finishing position suggests latest but is two poor runs from two here.

runners.breeder: S C E A Du Haras Des Sablonnets Et Al
runners.comment: 0-10 for Tony Carroll and is only slowly coming down the weights
runners.name: Brodies Boy
runners.spotlight: Sole win came in 1m4f maiden here just over two years ago; 0-10 for Tony Carroll and is only slowly coming down the weights; has undergone wind surgery since last seen; goes without headgear.

runners.comment: Out of form and isn't one to pop up unexpectedly; non-runner
runners.name: The Bay Warrior
runners.spotlight: Twice scored off higher marks last year but produced another lacklustre display when behind two of these latest; isn't one to pop up unexpectedly (all seven wins gained at odds of 17-2 or shorter); non-runner.

runners.comment: Rather watch having reportedly bled last time
runners.name: Ice Opera
runners.spotlight: Could put the pace to the race; breakthrough win at Wolverhampton in January (1m4f) came out of the blue, for all she was dropping into a classified for the first time; bombed out (though reportedly bled) when carrying 5lb penalty in handicap under same conditions just three days later; rather watch.

20:30.race_name: Virgin Bet Handicap (London Middle Distance Series Qualifier) (Div II)

runners.comment: Lot to like and can be expected to build on a fine stable debut
runners.name: Kings Hand
runners.spotlight: Broke through for Sir Mark Prescott at Lingfield in January (1m2f) and changed hands for 32,000gns after; achieved more in finishing runner-up over that track and trip 18 days ago and could have done with a stiffer test; a bold showing from his conqueror Sea Founder in the 7.00 would increase confidence; same mark here; Luke Morris, who knows him well, gets back aboard.

runners.breeder: Lofts Hall Stud B Sangster New England
runners.comment: Back on a mark in the 60s and has a squeak
runners.name: Tortured Soul
runners.spotlight: Signed off 2025 and began 2026 in winning form; like before, a mark in the 70s has proved tough of late but he showed a bit in a deeper race over track and trip two weeks ago; squeak; one of two runners for Tony Carroll.

runners.comment: Form figures here when tackling 1m3f+ read 133122 and Rossa Ryan gets the leg up
runners.name: Solanna
runners.spotlight: Form figures here when tackling 1m3f+ read 133122 and Rossa Ryan who, before today, is 5-18 (+8.88) for the yard in the last five years, gets the leg up for the first time; Wolverhampton isn't his track but he ran okay there off a break last time.

runners.comment: Leap of faith required to support on what we've seen in two British starts
runners.name: Now The Eagle
runners.spotlight: Twice placed in France but leap of faith required to support on what we've seen in two British starts; reportedly made a respiratory noise when nibbled at last time.

runners.comment: Failed to beat a rival sole start here and same outcome at Chelmsford 25 days ago
runners.name: Annexation
runners.spotlight: This 10yo, who has won eight times, failed to beat a rival sole start here and same outcome at Chelmsford 25 days ago (typically pulled hard both times); one of two runners for Tony Carroll.

runners.comment: Shortlisted with 1m3f around here likely to prove enough of a test
runners.name: Seventy
runners.spotlight: Broke through under Callum Shepherd at Lingfield last month (1m4f); didn't find 9.4f at Wolverhampton or 1m2f at Lingfield, where he pulled particularly hard in an apprentice race, enough of a test either side; shortlisted.

runners.breeder: Exors Of The Late Mrs B E Moore
runners.comment: Twice placed in first-time headgear over this trip at Southwell; this is tougher
runners.name: Arths Gold
runners.spotlight: Twice placed in first-time headgear over this trip at Southwell, most recently when sporting blinkers (retained) 18 days ago; this is tougher.

runners.comment: Form claims; settling him early with a furlong further to race will be the key
runners.name: Muy Muy Loco
runners.spotlight: Finished two places behind Seventy over 1m2f at Lingfield 19 days ago, having won over the same track and trip under Harry Davies the time before; settling him early with a furlong further to race will be the key.
